properties.title: Building 3D Digital Twins with PLATEAU, Point Clouds, and Vector Data with Cesium
properties.description:
Using real-world datasets such as PLATEAU, participants will build a digital twin by integrating 3D city models, point clouds, and vector data. Through hands-on exercises with Cesium and 3D Tiles, attendees will learn visualization, styling, attribute exploration, and basic spatial analysis in a web-based 3D environment.

Japan has made a wide range of high-quality geospatial datasets publicly available, including PLATEAU 3D city models and other open geospatial data. However, integrating and effectively utilizing different types of geospatial data—such as 3D city models, point clouds, and vector data—remains a challenge.
In this workshop, participants will learn a practical workflow for visualizing and analyzing these datasets within a common 3D environment using Cesium and OGC 3D Tiles.
Through hands-on exercises, participants will explore:
•	Visualizing and navigating 3D city models based on PLATEAU
•	Working with point cloud datasets and their attributes
•	Overlaying and styling vector datasets
•	Attribute-driven filtering and basic spatial analysis
Participants will gain practical experience combining multiple geospatial data types in a unified 3D environment and learn how these workflows can be applied to digital twins, disaster management, urban planning, and infrastructure management.
The workshop will also provide an overview of the latest developments in 3D Tiles 2.0, including emerging workflows for vector data and point cloud integration, as well as recent trends in web-based 3D GIS and digital twin technologies.
(Japanese-language support and Q&A will be available throughout the workshop.)
Requirements: 
Cesium ion: grab you Cesium Ion Account (free) at https://ion.cesium.com/
Install VS Code: https://code.visualstudio.com/download
Install Node.js: https://nodejs.org/en/download　(choose the default v24.19.0 LTS)
